A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the performance of the intelligent distributed system is better than Femto system with universal frequency reuse, but it is still better than the distributed system without intelligence.
the intelligent distributed system performs the best at light to medium traffic load, while the Femto system with frequency reuse 3 performs the best at heavy load.

the distributed intelligent system has the best cell-edge user throughput performance, the centralized intelligent system has the lowest interference, while the Femto cell system is a good compromise for the trade-off between performance and interference.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the traffic model has a significant effect on the performance of in-building wireless systems and the relative performance between the different in-building systems is also dependent on the traffic load and the number of access points deployed.
the relative performance of different in-building solutions is strongly dependent on the traffic load and traffic model.
the performance of the different solutions should be evaluated in a realistic traffic model to obtain a fair comparison.
